Troubleshooting · 17/50 · audio

Audio sample-rate mismatch

Failure signal

A audio sample-rate mismatch condition is reported or detected during audio.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for audio does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Inspect actual sample rates and duration against the timeline clock.

Corrective action

Resample once with an approved high-quality process and verify sync end to end.

Prevention

Add this verification to the audio gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
